On a state change the new state is stored at this[74*a2+123], sub_5506A0(state, 0, 0) updates the primary slot, and the sound effect slot array (dword_8AD3EC .. unk_8AD3F8) is iterated applying sub_5506A0(this[731], slot, 0) to each non-zero entry. Returns the current state. Called from VehiclePhysicsTimeStep, SubslotCleanup and sub_4F0430.
